Class Lesson

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.Lesson
public class Lesson extends Object

Title: Lesson Class.

Description: This class represents one persistent Lessons Learned entry. A lesson stores the identification of the lesson, its contributor, along with the title, problem, solution, and experience information which is optional.

The attributes support the User Stories. The id identifies the lesson, ownerId identifies the contributor who created it, title identifies the lesson to users, problem describes the situation being addressed, solution records what was done, and experience stores additional information learned.

This class provides input validation and persistent Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations. This design can be extended with additional attributes needed in later project phases, including refinement, searching, locking, visibility, and effort statistics. experience information.

Author:
Ahmad El-Merhaby

    • Lesson

      public Lesson(int id, int ownerId, String title, String problem, String solution, String experience)
      Creates a Lesson object using the lesson identification, contributor, title problem, solution and experience information(optional). Text values are trimmed before validation so that whitespace only required input is rejected and stored lengths match the validation lengths
      Parameters:
      id - the persistent identification of the lesson
      ownerId - the identification of the contributor who created the lesson
      title - the lesson title
      problem - the problem or situation
      solution - the recorded solution or lesson learned
      experience - optional experience information
